lesson.name: Learn The Scotch Game
lesson.description: If White wants to imbalance the game after 1.e4 e5, the Scotch Game is an excellent idea. White takes over the center, but Black can often gain a lead in development. Learn the key ideas for both sides.

{It's best for Black to trade on d4 in the Scotch Game. How can White force a
good endgame after 3...d6?} 4. dxe5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again
and look for a way to force a good endgame.] [%hint Trade pawns to open the
d-file.]} (4. d5 $5 {This is OK, but let's force an advantageous endgame. How
can you do it?}) (4. Bb5 $5 {This is OK, but let's force an advantageous
endgame. How can you do it?}) (4. Nc3 $5 {This is OK, but let's force an
advantageous endgame. How can you do it?}) (4. c3 $5 {This is OK, but let's
force an advantageous endgame. How can you do it?}) 4... dxe5 {Good start!
What's next?} 5. Qxd8+ {[%wrong Black is OK. Try again and look for a way to
force a good endgame.] [%hint Trade queens.] Great job! Black must capture
with the king to avoid losing the e5-pawn, but then Black can't castle and
White keeps a great position.} *

{How should Black gain an advantage against White's dubious Nb5?} 6... Bxe3 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a strong forcing option.]
[%hint Find a good capture.]} (6... Bb4+ $2 7. N1c3 {White continues to
develop and still threatens the fork on c7. Try again and look for a better
bishop move.}) (6... Qd8 $2 7. Bxc5 {White wins a piece. Try again and look for
a more forcing option.}) (6... Bb6 $2 7. Bxb6 {White removes the defender of
the c7-pawn. Try again and look for a better bishop move.}) (6... Bd6 $2 7.
Nxd6+ {White damages Black's pawn structure with a great position. Try again
and look for a stronger bishop move.}) (6... Qxb2 $2 7. Bxc5 {White wins a
piece and threatens a fork on c7. Try again and look for a better capture.}) (
6... Kd8 $2 7. Bxc5 {White wins material. Try again and look for a strong
capture.}) 7. fxe3 {Great move! How should you take advantage of the exposed
white king?} Qh4+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a
strong forcing move.] [%hint Find a good check.] Great job! White must play g3,
after which either the complicated Qxe4 or the safe Qd8 gives Black a good game.
} (7... Qd8 $2 8. Qg4 {White attacks g7 with a dangerous initiative. Try again
and look for a more forcing option.}) (7... Qe5 $2 8. Qd5 {White is OK. Try
again and look for a more forcing option.}) (7... Qxb2 $2 8. N1c3 {White
threatens both a fork on c7 and Rb1 to trap the black queen. Try again and
look for a more forcing option.}) (7... Kd8 $2 8. N1c3 {There's no need to
give up castling rights. Try again and look for a more forcing option.}) *

{In this critical position from the Scotch Mieses Variation, Black can
equalize with precise play. How should you initiatiate a set of exchanges to
reach an endgame with chances for both sides?} 13... Bxe5 {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Find a safe way to
capture the e5-pawn.]} (13... Nb6 $2 14. Nd2 {White connects the rooks with a
better pawn structure. Try again and look for a good capture.}) (13... Nb4 $2
14. a3 {The knight must move again and White is doing well. Try again and look
for a strong capture.}) (13... f6 $2 14. Qd2 {White unpins the c4-pawn with a
strong attacking position. Try again and look for a useful capture.}) (13... d6
$2 14. Qd2 {White unpins the c4-pawn with a strong attacking position. Try
again and look for a useful capture.}) (13... Qxe5 $2 14. Bxe5 $2 {White wins
the queen. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) 14. Qxe5 {Good start!
What's next?} Qxe5 {[%wrong White wins material. Try again and look for a good
capture.] [%hint Recapture.]} 15. Bxe5 {Keep it up!} Rxe5 {[%wrong White has a
winning material advantage. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint
Capture an undefended piece.]} 16. cxd5 {Nice move! With the queens off, White
can finally capture on d5, but Black is still OK. How can you prove it?} Bxf1 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint
The c4-pawn was pinned. What can you capture?]} (16... cxd5 $2 17. Rd1 {
White keeps a material advantage. Try again and look for a stronger capture.})
17. Kxf1 {Nice move! What should you capture next?} cxd5 {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture a pawn.]
Great work! You can find one more key move from the grandmaster battle Aronian
- Amin, 2019 in the next challenge.} (17... Rfe8 $2 18. Nc3 {White keeps a
material advantage. Try again and look for a good capture.}) *
